purpose: Teach: 除雪/透過/発芽/絶縁/局所/鮮度/生鮮/基板

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、駐車場の除雪契約を更新しろ
lines.en: We need to renew the parking lot snow removal contract.
lines.style: Direct, clipped delivery. Each phrase lands without softening. Composed authority—this is instruction, not discussion. Brief eye contact before moving to the next thing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品の透過率データを公表します
lines.en: Understood. I'll publish the transmittance data for the new product.
lines.style: Respectful, efficient acknowledgment. Slight bow of the head. Measured pace—showing he's cataloguing the task, not rushing it. Professional formality without stiffness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新市場での発芽期を見極めろ
lines.en: Assess the critical window for growth in our new markets.
lines.style: Declarative, unhurried. Weight on 「見極める」—this matters. Composed tone that expects competence. No preamble, no hedging.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。事業の絶縁的撤退も視野に入れます
lines.en: Understood. I'll also factor in the possibility of strategic withdrawal if needed.
lines.style: Calm, slightly thoughtful delivery. He's showing he's thinking two steps ahead. Respectful pause after 「視野に入れます」—demonstrating he's absorbed the nuance, not just the order.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 局所市場の動向を分析しろ
lines.style: Terse, economical. The rhythm quickens slightly—efficiency, not impatience. Final word has finality. This is the third command in sequence; the tone consolidates authority without repetition.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。食材の鮮度管理を徹底します
lines.en: Understood. I'll tighten our freshness protocols across the ingredient supply chain.
lines.style: Steady, committed. He's pivoting to the fresh-food initiative—showing he's tracking the shift in priorities. Slightly firmer tone than the previous acknowledgment, signalling engagement with this new focus.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、生鮮食品事業を強化しろ
lines.style: Clear, resolute delivery. This is the pivot point—Hiroshi is redirecting the company's focus. No hesitation. The tone carries the weight of a business decision, not a suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。電子基板の調達網を見直します
lines.en: Understood. I'll review and reorganize our electronic components procurement network.
lines.style: Professional closure. Slightly slower, more deliberate pacing—signalling this is the final acknowledgment of the sequence. Respectful without servility. A summary nod rather than eager assent.
